findings.title: CI has no test/lint/typecheck job at all - every gate in the repo is local-only and unenforced
findings.evidence: `ls .github/workflows/` -> `release.yml` only. Its trigger is `on: push: tags: ["v*"]` + workflow_dispatch; grep for `pytest|npm run|tsc|lint` in it returns nothing. The only build-time gate anywhere is Dockerfile:22 `RUN npm run build` (= tsc -b && vite build), and that runs only when a v* tag is pushed. No push/PR workflow exists, so `pytest tests/`, `npx tsc -b`, `npm run check`, `npm run lint` and all scripts/check_*.py are never executed by CI.
findings.impact: A commit that breaks 500 backend tests, fails tsc, or leaks a secret can be pushed to main and stay green on GitHub indefinitely. The repo's gate set is a set of local conventions; nothing enforces them. The single workflow that does exist (Release) can succeed with a completely broken build as long as `vite build` emits.
findings.fix_hint: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml: jobs backend (python -m pytest tests/ -q), frontend (npx tsc -b && npm run check), lint-ratchet (eslint --max-warnings with the 32-problem baseline). Trigger on push + pull_request.

findings.title: 16 of 30 `npm run check` scripts are regex-over-source; mutation proves one passes with the behavior deleted
findings.evidence: Classification by `grep -c readFileSync` vs `grep -c 'rolldown|await import('` over scripts/run_*.mjs: 16 scripts have readFileSync>0 and exec==0 (pure text match on .tsx/.py source), 12 execute the module, 2 are mixed. Mutation test in a scratch copy outside the repo (/root/.hermes/cache/scratch/fe-probe, node_modules symlinked): replaced `source_format: importFormat === 'text' ? importSourceFormat : '',` (src/pages/Accounts.tsx:608) with `source_format: '',` and kept the original line as a comment -> `node scripts/run_import_format_checks.mjs` prints `{"checked":4,"failures":[]}` exit 0. The regex `/importFormat === 'text' \? importSourceFormat : ''/` matches the comment.
findings.impact: `npm run check` reports 'all checks passed' for a tree where text-format import no longer sends source_format, i.e. the multi-column `----` parser silently gets no column mapping. The gate checks that an identifier appears in a file, not that the operation happens. Same shape in run_account_row_field_checks, run_accounts_list_token_checks, run_all_actions_are_tasks_checks, run_authorized_bulk_checks, run_batch_capability_checks, run_detail_completeness_checks, run_form_hint_checks, run_grok_batch_default_checks, run_kiro_derived_paging_checks, run_panel_action_mapping_checks, run_panel_filter_driven_checks, run_panel_upload_entry_checks, run_probe_task_checks, run_proxy_release_checks, run_silent_failure_checks.
findings.fix_hint: For each source-regex script, either bundle the module with rolldown and assert on the produced object/request body (the pattern already used by run_panel_filter_checks / run_task_kind_checks), or delete the script and let tsc catch the removal. A comment should never satisfy an assertion.

findings.title: `npm run lint` exits 1 on the current tree; the documented gate chain `tsc -b && npm run lint && npm run build` can never reach the build
findings.evidence: `cd frontend && npm run lint` -> `✖ 32 problems (28 errors, 4 warnings)` exit 1, 91.61s. Rules: @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any 25, react-hooks/exhaustive-deps 4 (warnings), react-refresh/only-export-components 1, react-hooks/set-state-in-effect 1, no-empty 1; 8 files, worst src/pages/Accounts.tsx (15 errors) and src/pages/Settings.tsx (10). docs/MAINTENANCE.md:511 states the baseline IS 32 problems, and §4.1 (line ~505) prescribes `cd frontend && npx tsc -b && npm run lint && npm run build` as the gate sequence.
findings.impact: The documented verification command short-circuits at lint (exit 1) so `npm run build` never runs - anyone following the doc gets a red gate every time and learns to ignore it. Because the exit code is always 1, lint cannot be used as a pass/fail gate at all; 28 real errors (25 `any`) are normalized as 'historical baseline' and a regression from 32 -> 33 is only caught by a regex on the doc string in tests/test_maintenance_doc.py.
findings.fix_hint: Split into `npm run lint:ratchet` (fails when problems > 32, passes otherwise) and `npm run lint` (informational). Fix the doc chain to use the ratchet. Ideally burn down the 25 `any` and set --max-warnings 0.

findings.title: Collected-test-count gate is one-directional with 41% slack: asserts >=2300 while the suite collects 3929
findings.evidence: `test_collected_test_count_is_in_the_documented_ballpark` runs `pytest tests/ --collect-only -q`, parses `(\d+) tests collected` (actual: 3929) then `self.assertGreaterEqual(collected, 2300)`. docs/MAINTENANCE.md:502 says '2300+ 用例' and pytest.ini:17 says 'pytest tests/ -> 3514 collected'.
findings.impact: 1,629 tests (41% of the suite) can be deleted, skipped or made uncollectable and this gate still passes. The number is also stale in both docs (2300+/3514 vs 3929), so it no longer measures what the author thought.
findings.fix_hint: Pin `collected == 3929` (updated with the suite) or a floor within 2% (>=3850), and have it fail on a drop as well as a parse failure. Update MAINTENANCE.md and the pytest.ini comment.

findings.title: check_dead_tests.py only sees tests inside `if __name__ == "__main__"` and silently skips files that fail to parse
findings.evidence: find_dead_tests() walks only `tree.body` guards matched by _is_main_guard (line 51-56). main() has `except SyntaxError: continue` (line 70-71) - a test file with a syntax error is dropped from the scan instead of reported. Nothing detects: @pytest.mark.skip/skipif, a TestCase class with __init__ (pytest warns and skips the whole class), a file renamed off the test_*.py glob, or a test shadowed by a duplicate class definition.
findings.impact: The gate's name and docstring promise 'no test can never be collected'; it covers exactly one of at least five ways a test becomes uncollectable. It reports exit 0 (4.00s) today, which is read as 'no dead tests'.
findings.fix_hint: Fail on SyntaxError rather than continue. Cross-check pytest's own `--collect-only` count against the number of `def test_*` in tests/ (AST) and report the delta - that catches every skip/shadow class at once.

findings.title: The pytest-side typecheck gate self-skips when node_modules is absent - '3929 passed' can mean tsc never ran
findings.evidence: `test_typescript_still_compiles` calls `self.skipTest("未安装 npx —— 跳过 tsc 编译检查")` when shutil.which('npx') is None and again when frontend/node_modules is missing, before running `npx tsc -b`. Same pattern: 4 `@pytest.mark.skipif(not os.path.isdir(frontend/node_modules))` decorators in tests/test_frontend_running_tasks_cap.py:23,44,67,94. tests/test_maintenance_doc.py:108 has the same skip for the eslint baseline check.
findings.impact: On a clean CI checkout (no npm install) the only pytest-visible typecheck gate, the only eslint-baseline gate and 4 frontend contract tests all skip silently; the run is green and reports 'passed'. The skip is unconditional - it does not distinguish 'developer laptop' from 'CI'.
findings.fix_hint: Skip only when an explicit env var (e.g. ALLOW_MISSING_NODE=1) is set; otherwise fail with an actionable message. In CI, `npm ci` before pytest.

findings.title: `npm run check` discards every script's stdout to /dev/null and validates no script's `checked` count
findings.evidence: `"check": "for f in scripts/run_*.mjs; do node \"$f\" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo 'all checks passed'"`. The 25 scripts that print `{checked, failures}` do so on stdout only, so on failure the operator sees exit 1 and zero diagnostics. No script is required to assert a minimum `checked`; e.g. run_dashboard_tasks_checks reports checked=2, run_kiro_derived_paging_checks checked=3 - a loop over an empty discovered list yields checked=0, failures=[] and exit 0.
findings.impact: A failing check is indistinguishable from a crashing one, and an empty-iteration check is indistinguishable from a thorough one. The only place a floor is asserted is tests/test_frontend_running_tasks_cap.py (`result['checked'] >= 13`), for one script.
findings.fix_hint: Drop the `> /dev/null` (or tee to a log and print the last line on failure). Add a shared helper that fails when `checked < N` for each script.

findings.title: Two 'frontend' check scripts assert on backend Python source text
findings.evidence: `readFileSync(new URL('../../platforms/grok/plugin.py', import.meta.url), 'utf8')` in run_grok_batch_default_checks.mjs:13, and `readFileSync(new URL('../../core/config_schema.py', ...))` in run_maintenance_keys_checks.mjs:18. Discovered when running `npm run check` in a scratch copy that contained only frontend/: it died with `path: '/root/.hermes/cache/scratch/platforms/grok/plugin.py'`.
findings.impact: A frontend gate red-lines on a Python refactor and vice versa; the coupling is invisible from either side, and the check is still only a substring match on the Python file (same weakness as L09-2).
findings.fix_hint: Move these assertions into the pytest suite where the Python symbol can be imported and called, and keep the frontend script to frontend inputs.

findings.title: check_no_secrets only scans git-tracked files and skips any match containing TEST/FAKE/DUMMY
findings.evidence: _tracked_files() shells out to `git ls-files -z` (line 45) and falls back to a directory walk only when git is unavailable, so untracked files are never scanned. `if any(marker in value.upper() for marker in FAKE_MARKERS): continue` where FAKE_MARKERS = (FAKE, EXAMPLE, SAMPLE, PLACEHOLDER, DUMMY, REDACTED, TEST) - a live `sk-...TEST...` key is skipped. SKIP_DIRS also drops `data`, `static`, `reference`. Ran: exit 0, 5.40s, prints '未发现密钥字面量。'
findings.impact: The guard is run before `git add` in practice (it is a pre-commit style check), where new files are exactly the untracked ones it cannot see. It is a real regex scanner (would catch AKIA.../ghp_... in tracked files) but its coverage claim is broader than its reach.
findings.fix_hint: Scan `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard` so new files are included; drop 'TEST' from FAKE_MARKERS (keep FAKE/EXAMPLE/DUMMY) or require the marker to be a whole token.

findings.title: pytest.ini's own comment cites a stale collection count (3514 vs 3929)
findings.evidence: pytest.ini comment: '`pytest tests/` → 3514 collected + 0 error'. Actual: `pytest --collect-only -q` -> '3929 tests collected in 4.36s'.
findings.impact: Cosmetic, but it is the number a reviewer uses to decide whether a suite run lost tests; a 415-test gap reads as a collection regression that never happened.
findings.fix_hint: Update the comment, or delete the number and point at tests/test_maintenance_doc.py as the source of truth.

checked_and_clean.item: tsc -b actually type-checks (not a no-op / not an empty solution)
checked_and_clean.how: Read the tsconfig graph: tsconfig.json is solution-style with files:[] and references to tsconfig.app.json (include:["src"], strict, noUnusedLocals, noEmit) and tsconfig.node.json (include:["vite.config.ts"]). Mutation-checked outside the repo: copied src+tsconfigs to /root/.hermes/cache/scratch/fe-probe with node_modules symlinked, baseline `npx tsc -b` exit 0, then added src/__probe_type_error.ts containing `const __probe: number = "not a number"` -> exit 2 with `error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'`. The unimported file was still checked, so include-based coverage is real. Clean run: exit 0, 36.92s cold.

checked_and_clean.item: e2e_smoke.py is a real black-box run
checked_and_clean.how: `python scripts/e2e_smoke.py` -> exit 0, 10.39s, 21 steps, failed:0, ok:true, against a real FastAPI TestClient with a temp DATA_DIR. It asserts status<400 per named step and <500 for the --sweep route scan. Not wired into CI or into any pytest test (checked: no reference to e2e_smoke in .github/ or tests/).

checked_and_clean.item: frozen_verify.py is a genuine tree-immutability gate
checked_and_clean.how: Read scripts/frozen_verify.py: snapshot() hashes HEAD + `git status --porcelain=v1 -z` + every `git ls-files` blob; mismatch returns exit 2 with a distinct message. `python scripts/frozen_verify.py` alone exits 2 (argparse: needs `-- <command>`), so it is a wrapper, not a gate; no workflow or script invokes it.

checked_and_clean.item: check_kiro_agent2api_export.py asserts a built payload, not source text
checked_and_clean.how: Read scripts/check_kiro_agent2api_export.py: builds AccountRecord + platforms.kiro.credentials.build_extra and inspects the exported dict (id non-empty, no `uid` identity fallback, loginProvider case). `python scripts/check_kiro_agent2api_export.py` -> exit 0, 1.38s.

AST scan of all 289 test files: 3841 test functions, 26 with no assert/raises/fail. All 26 read as 'must not raise' cases (test_console_broken_pipe, test_grok_browser_close_timeout, test_icloud_upstream_gate, test_task_store_io). Legitimate shape, not decoration.

checked_and_clean.item: Tests that patch the function they claim to test
checked_and_clean.how: Heuristic scan of 754 patch()/patch.object() sites; 60 files patch an attribute of a module they also import. Spot-checked the highest-density ones (test_chatgpt_token_refresh_verification 15, test_panel_comparison 30, test_cliproxyapi_sync 19, test_environment_preflight 9, test_grok_exit_probe 9): every target is a collaborator (AuthFlow, _request_json, FETCHERS, engine, _camouflage_* probes, time.sleep), not the unit under test. No confirmed self-patch found. Not exhaustively verified for all 60.

testpaths=tests + norecursedirs=.git .venv .worktrees reference node_modules dist build. `pytest --collect-only -q` -> 3929 collected, 0 errors in 4.36s; no import-mismatch errors, so the .worktrees/reference collision described in the comment is genuinely fixed.

tests/conftest.py sets DATA_DIR and DATABASE_URL to TemporaryDirectory before importing core.db, sets APP_ENABLE_SOLVER=0 and APP_TRUST_TEST_CLIENT=1, and disposes the engine in pytest_sessionfinish. No real data/platforms/ writes during collection.
